description: ProGarLabs is a technology lab from Osorno, Chile, combining GIS, machine learning, software engineering, UI/UX and product design. We're tackling NASA Space Apps 2026's Earth System Trend Detective challenge to explore NASA data, identify environmental trends and assess their significance. We welcome collaborators in Earth science, remote sensing, climate data, statistics and time-series analysis. Join us to build a scientifically rigorous, open and impactful solution!
